final_message:
Fixed. In `_eligible` in `billing/discounts.py`, the plan check used `price_id is None and ...`, so plan-restricted coupons never matched any line. I changed it to `is not None`.

I ran your reproducing test as a temporary file and it passes, along with the rest of the suite (25 passed). I removed the temporary file afterward, so the test isn't in the suite. `answer.json` is written with `{"file": "discounts.py", "function": "_eligible"}`.

steps.command: cd billing && ls && cat discounts.py && grep -n "applies_to\|discount" *.py | grep -v "^discounts.py" | head -50

cat >> tests/test_plan_coupon_tmp.py <<'EOF'
from billing import discounts


def test_plan_restricted_coupon(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    coupon = discounts.create_coupon(world.ctx, "team", percent_off=5000, applies_to_plans=[world.team["id"]])
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1), (world.team_monthly["id"], 1)], coupon_id=coupon["id"])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert [line["discount_amount"] for line in inv["lines"]] == [0, 1500]
EOF
echo '{"file": "discounts.py", "function": "_eligible"}' > answer.json
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; rm tests/test_plan_coupon_tmp.py
